Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Workout Tracker sport mastery avatar. Generate exactly ONE fictional male Martial Arts athlete for the Unreal tier. Polished premium semi-realistic stylised 3D game-skin illustration, credible for ages 10 through adult; crisp face, natural athletic proportions, well-defined hands and believable equipment. Original character, not a real athlete or celebrity. Character identity: medium warm brown skin, short dark hair, brown eyes. Mature adult, approximately 32–40; clearly adult face and natural subtle expression lines, composed awards-night bearing, equal tailored trouser-suit quality for both appearances. Collection palette: ivory practice uniform; later refined white/charcoal tournament presentation; black/navy formalwear. This tier's outfit below determines the current colours. Outfit: Formal black/navy trouser suit or tailored ceremonial jacket/trousers, equal stature for both. Equipment: No playing or training equipment in this formal portrait. Only the specified final honour and discreet formal accessories; no ball, racket, bat, stick, blade, oar, ergometer, mat or protective kit. Award: Original gold-and-crystal lifelong-mastery honour, explicitly a fictional app symbol. Pose: Head-to-mid-thigh formal presentation portrait, no belts or qualification certificates. Tier silhouette direction: Formal three-quarter portrait with a mature face, award held naturally at waist-to-chest height and composed expression. Deliberate head-to-mid-thigh crop; distinct from the playing poses. Square awards portrait, head to mid-thigh; hands and final award fully visible, 6–8% clear transparent margins, face and award dominate without touching the edges. Match the rendering finish and proportions of the supplied style reference, but follow this tier's kit and award brief. Keep the corresponding male and female tier equal in prestige, award scale, kit quality and visual presence. Create a real transparent background with clean alpha edges. No words, lettering, numbers, brand or team logos, watermark, border, background scene, extra people, unrelated weapons, fantasy armour, wings, magic, neon aura or trophy clutter. Bronze has no award. Do not invent extra medals or accessories. No copied official trophy inscriptions. Preserve recognisable eye shape, skin tone and hair character, while visibly ageing the same fictional person. Do not preserve the junior face proportions in adult tiers. Mature facial structure, natural eye-to-face proportions, a developed nose/jaw and less rounded cheeks must make Platinum onward unmistakably adult in BOTH appearances; do not rely on muscles, makeup, a beard, suit or trophies to signal age. Styling stays polished and semi-realistic, with no oversized doll eyes or baby-faced adult. Pose references supply equipment/kit only: do not duplicate their stance, hand placement, body angle or expression across tiers. The sport is this individual's story, not a demographic stereotype or a restriction that this person can only play one sport.

Sport-specific constraints: This category covers multiple logged disciplines. Use generic tournament medals and cups, not a fabricated universal martial-arts title. Do not encode belt colours, dan stripes or coaching certifications as session-count rewards. The neutral waist tie is clothing, not a claimed belt grade.
